name: @papercusp/search
description: Host-agnostic BM25 + pgvector hybrid search over Postgres. The host registers pluggable SearchSources (each owning its tsvector/pgvector SQL); the engine runs BM25-only or BM25+embeddings fused via Reciprocal Rank Fusion. PG handle + query embedder are injected — zero schema coupling, zero embedding-provider dependency.
